general.ayuda: Each awarded and accepted position will have its own case. The proposal and decision will be handled later in each person's case.
general.sin_oferta: This case has no confirmed offer for multiple positions.
general.sin_aceptadas: There are no awarded positions with prior acceptance yet.
general.confirmar_advertencia: VEC will check the award and acceptance before creating the case. Review the receipt before continuing.
general.incierto: The result could not be confirmed. Check it before repeating the same request.
general.confirmado: Case created with a receipt. Open it to continue.
general.error_consulta: Positions or cases could not be checked. Retry the lookup.
general.error_oferta_pagina: The linked offer is not fully available in the Job Pool response. Try again later.
general.error_403: You do not have permission to view or create this case.
general.error_409: The data changed or this position already has a case. Refresh the case.
general.error_503: The service needed to create the case is unavailable. Try again later.
general.error_generico: The case could not be created. Check the result before trying again.
general.sin_montaje: Appointments cannot be checked now. Reload the case.
